config.task: Matched control: identical two-head model, loss, threshold selection and decoder, but the second head is trained on all nucleus contours instead of only nucleus-nucleus contacts
config.purpose: Ten-seed target ablation for the contact-aware formulation
config.augmentation: uniform rotations by multiples of 90 degrees and horizontal flip with probability 0.5
config.loss: foreground Dice+BCE plus 0.5 times contact-boundary Dice+positive-weighted BCE
config.selection: highest validation Caicedo object-F1; contact threshold selected on validation only
config.postprocessing: identical to bbbc_contact_10seed: remove predicted boundary pixels from foreground to form markers, then assign all foreground pixels to their nearest marker
config.primary_endpoint: Caicedo average object F1 over IoU thresholds 0.50 to 0.90
